versioning.backwardCompatibility: A v1 reader must supply documented defaults for absent optional v1 fields and preserve unknown optional fields.
versioning.forwardCompatibility: A same-major future writer may be previewed only when every requiredFeature is supported; unknown optional fields are preserved and never interpreted.
versioning.canonicalJsonEncoding: UTF-8 without BOM; canonical object keys for hashes; LF text output

playlistBoundary.offlineSavedUserBoundary: Current offline saved-user selection never becomes track provenance. Entry provenance is the explicit server/user captured with the media identity.
playlistBoundary.copyOrConvertPolicy: No implicit conversion, overwrite, or identity transfer; user must explicitly choose a copy/merge strategy.
playlistBoundary.titlePolicy: Playlist name and track title are display data, never merge keys or provenance.

priority: SERVER_SOURCE: identityVersion + mediaKind + SERVER + serverId + userId + libraryId + itemId + sourceToken
LOCAL_SOURCE: identityVersion + mediaKind + LOCAL + localItemId + persistentUri
SERVER_REQUEST_ONLY: serverId + userId + libraryId + itemId with sourceToken=null; no source-level merge
mediaIdentity.dedupRule: Only two complete SOURCE identities may be presented as the same resolved source. Duplicates remain as separate ordered entries until an explicit policy is chosen.
mediaIdentity.serverUserRule: serverId and userId are mandatory and never inferred from the current session, current offline user, title, URI, or a bare itemId.
mediaIdentity.localRule: localItemId plus persistentUri define the local source. contentSha256 is auxiliary evidence only and cannot replace stable identity.
mediaIdentity.sourceTokenRule: sourceToken means an opaque stable media-source selector, never an authentication token.
mediaIdentity.missingSourceRule: sourceToken=null is REQUEST_ONLY and cannot claim playable/resolved source identity.
mediaIdentity.legacyRule: A record with unprovable source gets an independent legacyRecordKey and is never folded into a complete record.

importPolicy.orderInvariant: Positions must be unique, contiguous, and equal to physical entry order.

m3u8Contract.identityCarrier: AURORAMA-DOCUMENT-V1 and AURORAMA-ENTRY-V1 base64url JSON comments
m3u8Contract.commentGuarantee: Only this contract guarantees AURORAMA markers. Generic players and rewrite tools may discard comments.
m3u8Contract.genericImportPolicy: Create UNKNOWN/NO_MERGE entries from EXTINF+URI evidence; never infer identity from title or filename.
m3u8Contract.extXPolicy: Preserve-neutral EXT-X-VERSION may be read; HLS timing/master/key/map/range directives are unsupported and fail closed.
m3u8Contract.credentialPolicy: Authentication values are not exchange identity and must be redacted before export; sourceToken is not an auth credential.

roundtrip.jsonToJson: All recognized values and unknown optional JSON fields are preserved; conflicts/multiplicity remain visible.
roundtrip.jsonToM3u8ToJsonWithMarkers: Recognized contract data is byte-decodable and deep-equal when every AURORAMA marker survives.
roundtrip.jsonToM3u8ToJsonGeneric: Order/title/URI may survive, duration may degrade, and all playlist identity, entry identity, availability, extensions, and conflict semantics are explicitly LOSS.
roundtrip.secretUriRule: A redacted authenticated URI is DEGRADE, not PRESERVE; the missing credential is not synthesized.

memorySync.strategy: Repository evidence is the source of truth; do not duplicate this transient contract state into Engramory unless a durable non-repo convention is identified.
